card.name: Digits and units inside measurements
card.fires_on: Digits or unit pieces in the middle of a measurement, just before the unit (kg, m, mg, °F) is completed. Seen in weight ranges, height or area tables and conversion formulas.

modes.label: Digit before a unit
modes.description: A digit inside a number that is about to be followed by kg, mg or °F.
modes.example: Weighing 1.5 kg to Less than 4<<0>> kg Care should be taken during admixture

modes.label: Unit start or table measure
modes.description: The first piece of a unit word or a measure label in a data table, before the value is completed.

card.writes: It suppresses unit words such as miles, inches, minutes and dollars, so it appears to stop a new unit from being named right after a number.
card.plain: It fires inside a measurement, partway through a number or unit, when the unit has not yet been written.
